She is no longer wearing glasses and has switched into a white lace-trimmed, off-the-shoulder dress. The background has changed to a lighter beige or cream-colored curtain. She moves rhythmically to the beat, performing a shoulder roll, running her hands through her hair, and crossing her arms over her chest before ending with a playful punch toward the camera lens.
